summary: Go when the stalls are the reason: Cai Rang at dawn, Dong Xuan for wholesale goods, Ben Thanh if you agree the price first.
body: Cai Rang is wholesale boats on the river at Can Tho. Go with a small boat, not a late tour bus. Dong Xuan is the Old Quarter’s covered market, more useful for a look at wholesale goods than for souvenirs. Ben Thanh is the central market in Ho Chi Minh City. Agree the price before you buy.

Da Lat’s market is sloping halls of flowers, strawberries, and snacks. Go hungry in the morning. The night stalls spill nearby after 18:00. Hoi An’s market sits inside the ancient town, with a food hall the heritage note names for cao lầu. Chau Doc’s market is the start of that town: fish-noodle bowls, coffee, and boats unloading on the waterfront.
